entries.name: BIRDEYE_API_KEY
entries.description: The business's Birdeye API key. Birdeye keys carry no scopes, so the same key could reply to reviews; the connector only ever sends Get Reviews. It goes only to Birdeye, in an x-api-key header.
howToGet: In the Birdeye dashboard, find the business's API key (Birdeye support can point to it if it isn't shown).
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: BIRDEYE_BUSINESS_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the Birdeye business (location) whose reviews are read.
howToGet: Copy the business id from the Birdeye dashboard's business settings, or ask Birdeye support for it.
